activities.skill: Reading to put events in order
activities.directions: Read the text. Tap the pictures in the order the plant grows.
activities.directionsEs: Lee el texto. Toca los dibujos en el orden en que crece la planta.
passage: A plant begins as a seed in the soil.
With water and warmth, the seed sprouts. A tiny root grows down and a small stem grows up.
The stem grows leaves, and later a flower opens.
vocabulary: the part that holds up a plant
tallo: la parte que sostiene la planta
activities.correct: A seed sprouts, then grows leaves and a flower.
activities.hint: Tap a sentence to hear it. Read it with your finger under each word.
activities.support: Tap a sentence to hear it. Read it with your finger under each word.
activities.extension: Read the sentences again to a grown-up or a stuffed animal.

activities.title: A Letter's Trip
activities.skill: Reading to put steps in order
activities.directions: Read the text. Tap the pictures in the order the letter travels.
activities.directionsEs: Lee el texto. Toca los dibujos en el orden en que viaja la carta.
passage: Ana writes a letter to her grandma.
She puts a stamp on it and drops it in the mailbox.
A mail carrier picks it up. A truck carries it far away.
At last, another mail carrier brings it to her grandma's door.
vocabulary: a small paper that pays for mailing a letter
sello: papelito que paga el envío de una carta
a box where letters are left
buzón: caja donde se dejan las cartas
activities.correct: Write the letter, drop it in the mailbox, then a truck carries it.

activities.title: Sharing Cookies
activities.skill: Reading a number story to compare
activities.directions: Read the story. Tap who has more cookies now.
activities.directionsEs: Lee el cuento. Toca quién tiene más galletas ahora.
passage: Nina has six cookies. Jo has two cookies.
Nina gives Jo one cookie.
Now Nina has five cookies and Jo has three cookies.
vocabulary: compartir: dar un poco a otros
frames: ___ has more. Five is more than three.
activities.correct: Nina has five and Jo has three. Five is more than three.
